language.name: English
app.noHosting: Game servers run on Windows and Linux. On this computer you can explore the app, but not install or start servers.
describe.not-installed: Not installed yet. Install downloads the dedicated server from Steam.
describe.running: Running. Players on your network can join; friends over the internet need the ports below open.
describe.stopping: Saving the world and shutting down…
describe.crashed: The server stopped unexpectedly. Check the console, then start it again.
sidebar.emptyHint: Pick a game to get started.
catalog.title: Choose a game server
catalog.intro: Pick a game and NeledPort installs and runs the server for you. Not listed? Use any Steam App ID.
catalog.noMatch: No games match “{query}”. Try “Any Steam App ID”.
catalog.needsLogin: Needs a Steam account that owns it
catalog.needsLoginTitle: This server needs a Steam account that owns the game. You sign in once with SteamCMD.
add.intro: Defaults work for most people. You can change them later.
add.name: Server name
custom.title: Install any Steam dedicated server
custom.intro: NeledPort installs it with SteamCMD. After that you pick the program that starts it, once, and can share the setup with everyone.
custom.searchPlaceholder: Type a game name, e.g. Project Zomboid
server.removeConfirm: Remove “{name}” from NeledPort? Its files stay on disk.
server.hostOnly: Game servers run on Windows and Linux only
overview.noGracefulStop: On Windows, NeledPort asks {game} to save with Ctrl+C and backs up the world first. A game that does not answer is closed, so save in-game before stopping if you can.
overview.noBackups: No backups yet. One is made before every update.
overview.portsHint: Open these on your router so friends can join.
build.label: Build {build}
launch.choose: choose the program that starts this server. NeledPort remembers it.
launch.runs: Runs {program}. Works? Share it so everyone gets this game in the catalog.
console.empty: Nothing here yet. Output appears when the server installs or runs.
console.placeholder: Type a console command and press Enter
console.startFirst: Start the server to send commands
players.unsupported: This game does not report its players yet.
players.startFirst: Start the server to see who is online.
players.banNote: Saved through the game's own ban system, so bans stay when NeledPort is closed.
players.banNextJoin: This game applies a ban the next time the player joins.
players.banUnsupported: Banning is not available for this game yet.
mods.serverOnly: Runs on the server only; players install nothing.
mods.removeConfirm: Remove {loader}? Plugins stay in the folder.
mods.runningNote: Stop the server to install or remove the loader. Plugins can change while it runs.
mods.noPlugins: No plugins yet. Add a plugin file you downloaded.
mods.none: No one-click mods for this game yet. Know how its mods work? Add a mod loader to its definition.
workshop.title: Steam Workshop
workshop.intro: Paste a Workshop map link or id. The server downloads it and switches to it.
workshop.label: Workshop link or id
workshop.startFirst: Start the server to load Workshop items.
workshop.sent: Sent: loading Workshop item {id}. Watch the console for progress.
backups.intro: NeledPort keeps the newest {count} copies of each kind. One is made before every update.
backups.noSaveDir: NeledPort does not know where {game} keeps its world yet, so it cannot back it up.
backups.stopFirst: Stop the server to restore a backup
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore the world from {date}? The current world is kept in a folder next to it.
config.settingsHint: Changes apply the next time the server starts.
config.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the current one
config.fileHint: The game's own settings file. The previous version is kept as .neledport.bak.
config.adapterNote: Each start, NeledPort writes the server settings above into this file.
config.stopFirst: Stop the server to edit this file
update.confirmRunning: NeledPort asks running servers to save and stops them before it restarts. Continue?
steam.title: Steam account
steam.why: {game} needs a Steam account that owns it. NeledPort never sees your password: you sign in inside SteamCMD, Valve's own tool, and it remembers you.
steam.opened: A SteamCMD window opened. Type your password and Steam Guard code there. When it shows “Waiting for user info...OK”, close that window and press Check.
steam.notOk: {user} is not signed in. Sign in again.
dialog.chooseProgram: Choose the program that starts the server
quit.detail: NeledPort asks them to save and stops them before closing.
remote.title: Remote machines
remote.intro: Watch and control the game servers on another computer (a Linux VPS, a Windows Server), and let other computers watch this one. Each paired device has its own code, which you can revoke.
remote.unavailable: Remote access is not available: NeledPort's API could not start.
remote.alreadyRunning: NeledPort is already running on this computer (another window, or "neledport serve"). Close it first.
remote.addMachineHint: On that machine, turn on remote access and pair this computer (in NeledPort's Remote page, or "neledport devices add"), then enter its address and the code it shows.
remote.noServers: No game servers on this machine yet.
remote.confirm.stop: Stop {name} on {machine}? It saves first; players are disconnected.
remote.confirm.forget: Forget {machine}? Its code is deleted from this computer.
remote.confirm.revoke: Revoke {name}? It can no longer connect.
remote.accessHint: Off until you turn it on. Only paired devices can connect: a wrong code fails before anything is read, and an address that keeps trying is blocked for 15 minutes. Paired devices can never create or delete servers, install mods or change files.
remote.firewall: Open TCP {port} in this computer's firewall (and router, for access from the internet). Allow only your own addresses if you can, or use a VPN such as Tailscale.
remote.codeOnce: Shown only now. Enter it on that device; anyone with it can connect as that device until you revoke it.
remote.nothingToBackUp: {name} has no saves to back up yet.
